scope: Competition and finals terminology required by the Premiership intelligence layer.
source: NRL finals-series format and official competition usage

terms.plain_language: The regular-season title awarded to the team that finishes first on the NRL ladder after the regular season.
terms.research_use: Separate regular-season first place from the NRL Premiership decided through the finals series.

terms.plain_language: The post-regular-season competition involving the top eight teams and culminating in the Grand Final.
terms.research_use: Trace each qualifying club's path to the Premiership.

terms.plain_language: The eight ladder positions that qualify for the NRL finals series.
terms.research_use: Determine whether a Premiership path remains open.

terms.plain_language: Ladder positions one to four, which enter Week 1 through Qualifying Finals and can survive a Week 1 loss.
terms.research_use: Distinguish double-chance finals paths from elimination paths.

terms.plain_language: Ladder positions one and two, both of which host a Week 1 Qualifying Final under the standard finals format.
terms.research_use: Track home-final implications and Minor Premiership consequences.

terms.plain_language: A Week 1 finals match involving top-four teams. The winner advances directly to a Preliminary Final; the loser remains alive and plays a Semi-final.
terms.research_use: Model top-four Premiership pathways and Week 1 loss survivability.

terms.plain_language: A Week 1 finals match involving teams finishing fifth to eighth. The loser is eliminated and the winner advances to a Semi-final.
terms.research_use: Model sudden-death Premiership paths from positions five to eight.

terms.plain_language: A Week 2 sudden-death finals match. The winner advances to a Preliminary Final and the loser is eliminated.
terms.research_use: Trace the Week 2 branch of the finals path.

terms.plain_language: A Week 3 sudden-death finals match whose winner advances to the Grand Final.
terms.research_use: Trace the penultimate step to the Premiership.

terms.plain_language: The championship match at the end of the NRL finals series. Its winner is the NRL Premier.
Common description of the protection enjoyed by top-four teams because a Week 1 Qualifying Final loss does not eliminate them.
terms.research_use: Explain loss survivability without implying that any later loss can be survived.

terms.plain_language: The rest week earned by a Qualifying Final winner before the Preliminary Final.
terms.research_use: Model recovery and scheduling consequences of a Week 1 win.

terms.plain_language: The competition procedure used to separate teams level on competition points, beginning with the applicable points-differential and subsequent official criteria.
terms.research_use: Resolve Minor Premiership and seeding scenarios only from the official tiebreak procedure.

terms.plain_language: A finals match hosted by the team entitled to hosting rights under the finals format and verified seeding.
terms.research_use: Track venue and travel implications after seeding is confirmed.

terms.plain_language: A finals state in which losing the match ends the team's Premiership campaign.
terms.research_use: Distinguish elimination branches from top-four Week 1 protection.
